run_pre_training_app: run pre-training of a named app by dynamically importing and executing its train module
run_scaffold_main: run the scaffold main function with an app name and args to start training
resume_preempt_training: resume a preempted training run by passing resume_preempt=True to the scaffold main function
review_main_function: review the main scaffold function that dynamically imports app train modules via importlib
summarize_scaffold_entry: summarize the scaffold entry point that dispatches training to app-specific train modules
